name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Read Plex file size, container, bitrate, codecs, HDR data and actual stream indexes from the same playable file. Retain Jellyfin peer file sizes and bitrates without retaining upstream paths or headers. Refresh current Plex media information during playback and persist corrected sizes without replacing item IDs. Track source-specific poster selections and episode poster fallbacks. Keep offline/recovery notifications ordered, hide titles whose remaining sources are disabled, preserve known durations when peers report zero, and accept authenticated HEAD requests on the media relay. Reconcile playback paths immediately when a friend changes per-user access so permitted users keep playing while revoked URLs are denied.
